findings.message: The `prefs` cookie is fully controlled by the client, and `pickle.loads` on it lets anyone run arbitrary code on the server with a crafted payload. Never unpickle untrusted input.

When the cookie is absent, the default `""` decodes to `b""` and `pickle.loads(b"")` raises `EOFError`, so every request without the cookie fails with a server error. A malformed cookie also raises, and a value that is not a dict fails on `.get`, all instead of falling back to `"light"`.
The new `preferences` handler adds behaviour without any accompanying test.
